Quem somos Somos a EBAC Brasil A EBAC – EMPRESA BRASILEIRA DE APOIO AO COMPULSIVO É UM ORGANISMO CERTIFICADOR EM JOGO RESPONSÁVEL, atuando em parceria direta com as principais casas de apostas do país. Com base no art. 7º da Portaria da SPA, que orienta os operadores a “avaliar a possibilidade de obter certificação sobre jogo responsável, emitida por organismo que ofereça procedimento de certificação no tema”, oferecemos um caminho claro, confiável e eficiente para que as operadoras estejam em conformidade com a regulação brasileira. Nosso papel vai muito além do acolhimento. Somos o braço técnico que audita, orienta e certifica os operadores de apostas para que estejam em total conformidade com as exigências regulatórias do governo brasileiro. Aplicamos protocolos exclusivos que avaliam e atestam se os critérios de responsabilidade estão sendo cumpridos de forma ética e eficaz. Programa de conformidade e responsabilidade Nesta frente, a EBAC atua como organismo certificador independente, avaliando se a operadora está em conformidade com os critérios estabelecidos pelas portarias da SPA (Secretaria de Prêmios e Apostas). Auditoria dos requisitos legais e operacionais exigidos pela regulamentação brasileira; Emissão do selo “Empresa Responsável” para operadoras conformes; Treinamentos com as equipes internas (marketing, atendimento, vendas e afiliados); Sugestão de boas práticas de comunicação e limites éticos na publicidade; Produção de relatórios técnicos e análises periódicas, com insights e recomendações; Acompanhamento contínuo e atualização frente a novas portarias, auxiliando a operadora a se manter dentro das exigências do mercado regulado; Relacionamento com a indústria e follow‑up contínuo. Fazer Parte Transtorno do jogo Neste pilar, a EBAC atua diretamente na prevenção, identificação e acolhimento de apostadores com comportamento de risco ou em situação de transtorno compulsivo, protegendo tanto o apostador quanto a reputação da operadora. Aplicação de diagnósticos avançados, como o questionário PGSI e a Matriz de Compulsividade, para identificar perfis vulneráveis; Operacionalização do programa CompulSafe, com acolhimento, psicoeducação e curso de 8 semanas, com certificação ao apostador; Atendimento sigiloso e humanizado, disponível 24 h/7, realizado por equipe multidisciplinar; Treinamento de equipes de atendimento/chat para detecção precoce e encaminhamento correto dos apostadores vulneráveis; Relatórios personalizados enviados à operadora, com feedback e auditoria dos requisitos legais e operacionais exigidos pela regulamentação brasileira; Emissão do selo “Empresa Responsável” para operadoras conformes. Reconhecimento Melhor iniciativa de jogo responsável de 2025 Prêmio de excelência em boas práticas empresariais de JR e o selo CompulSafe, reconhecidos como diferenciais competitivos no setor. Compulsafe Detentora do Selo Compulsafe O CompulSafe é o programa da EBAC criado para acolher, orientar e educar jogadores com uso compulsivo de apostas. Com duração de 8 semanas, o curso oferece materiais didáticos e encontros online, promovendo a conscientização e o controle da compulsão. Mais que um curso, é um espaço seguro que não julga, escuta e propõe caminhos reais para transformar o jogo em uma prática saudável e de lazer. Quero conhecer mais Perguntas Frequentes Como funciona o atendimento da EBAC? Nosso modelo de atendimento A EBAC é uma empresa de ajuda nacional à pessoas com problemas compulsivos, especialmente vinculados aos jogos de azar. A EBAC opera através de telefone gratuito, vídeo chamadas, aplicativos de mensagens e de chat ao vivo), financiada por seus clientes corporativos. Esses serviços fornecem informações, conselhos e suporte individuais para qualquer pessoa afetada pelo problema com o jogo compulsivo – seja o próprio jogador, bem como outras pessoas que podem ser afetadas ou impactadas, como familiares e amigos. Nossa equipe está disponível 24 horas por dia e dispõe de uma variedade de intervenções breves e encaminhamentos para os clientes que contatam. A equipe modera nossos canais de comunicação e salas de apoio em grupo on-line. Serviços de Apoio EBAC A EBAC oferece uma variedade de encaminhamentos para pessoas afetadas por problemas de jogo. Trabalhamos com uma rede de parcerias em todo o país, que treinamos para oferecer esse serviço especializado gratuito. Trabalhamos individualmente e em grupos, e prestamos atendimento presencial, online ou por telefone. Sempre que apropriado, fazemos ligações com outros serviços locais para fornecer o melhor suporte para atender às necessidades do cliente. Uma Abordagem Baseada na Leveza Uma parte fundamental da nossa abordagem é a crença de que jogos se prestam ao entretenimento, ao incremento da inteligência e ao despertar de emoções que obrigatoriamente devem culminar em sentimentos de felicidade, alegria e autorrealização sustentável nas diversas dimensões da vida. Para alguém que teve problemas com jogos de azar, uma mudança de comportamento bem-sucedida e sustentada é significativamente mobilizada ao se colocar em prática as habilidades aprendidas individualmente ou em uma rede de apoio formada por pares e especialistas. Escolha do usuário do serviço A EBAC garante que os usuários do serviço possam fazer escolhas informadas sobre a variedade de opções disponíveis em cada etapa de sua jornada. Os objetivos e decisões do usuário do serviço são centrais para o plano de apoio e cuidados. Nosso objetivo é oferecer aos usuários do serviço opções mais saudáveis sobre como eles respondem a situações e seus gatilhos internos para compulsividade. Prática Baseada em Evidências Nossas intervenções são baseadas em formas de trabalho bem pesquisadas, principalmente que o jogo desempenha uma função na vida da pessoa. Utilizando uma abordagem analítica, nos concentramos na na identificação de gatilhos internos e externos, na prevenção de recaídas e gerenciamento de metas e na identificação de alternativas ao comportamento compulsivo. O uso de oportunidades para desenvolver e praticar habilidades é parte integrante dessa abordagem. Incentivamos o apoio de familiares e especialistas, bem como fornecemos apoio aos membros da família por direito próprio. Tudo isso é sustentado por uma forma motivacional de trabalhar dentro de um modelo de recuperação. Serviços seguros e eficazes Trabalhamos dentro de uma estrutura de governança robusta para garantir a prestação de serviços seguros e eficazes. Nossa prioridade é a proteção dos usuários de nossos serviços, suas famílias e outras pessoas que possam ser vulneráveis a danos devido à compulsividade. Todo o envolvimento com os usuários do serviço é direcionado para ajudá-los a alcançar os resultados desejados. Nossos processos de governança definem e gerenciam um conjunto acordado de indicadores de qualidade e medidas de resultados com os quais comparamos a eficácia de nossos serviços por meio de auditoria. Como o atendimento da EBAC pode me ajudar? Seu tratamento será adaptado às suas necessidades individuais. Os principais objetivos do programa COMPULSAFE são: Para ajudar a parar ou reduzir a frequência do comportamento compulsivo ligado ao jogo Para ajudar a desenvolver formas de lidar com o comportamento compulsivo do jogo Para ajudar a entender algumas das razões subjacentes pelas quais o jogo se tornou um problema Para ajudar a resolver problemas relacionados que estão causando danos ou prejuízos Para ajudar a desenvolver uma vida produtiva e saudável sem problemas de jogo Então você vai me dizer o que fazer? Não. Estamos aqui para apoiá-lo e ajudá-lo a entender melhor sua situação para que você possa identificar os objetivos que são importantes para você, afinal de conta fazer mudanças positivas em sua vida e dar passos para alcançá-lo é uma responsabilidade individuai e intransferível. Onde posso receber atendimento? Trabalhamos com vários canais para fornecer tratamento imediato. Se você gostaria de participar do Programa Compulsafe dê uma olhada em nossos canais. Em quanto tempo serei atendido? Entre em contato com nossos canais de atendimento. E se o atendimento não funcionar? O Programa Compulsafe pode funcionar de maneira diferente para cada um. O processo de mudança também é diferente para cada pessoa, mas receber apoio é uma boa maneira de começar a entender e fazer mudanças duradouras no comportamento compulsivo. Muitas vezes vale a pena conversar sobre o que está acontecendo com alguém em quem você confia, e a EBAC pode ajudá-lo com isso. Se você mudar de ideia sobre o tratamento a qualquer momento, a escolha é sua; no entanto, você pode falar com profissionais e pessoas da sua confiança sobre outras opções que também podem estar disponíveis. Como posso me inscrever? Dê uma olhada em nossos canais para encontrar o serviço que mais lhe seja conveniente ou te deixe à vontade. Posso indicar outra pessoa para atendimento? Se houver alguém que você conheça que possa se beneficiar de nossos serviços, recomende a EBAC e incentive-o a entrar em contato conosco para conversarmos sobre todas as opções disponíveis para apoio. Os familiares e profissionais que trabalham com alguém afetado pelo comportamento compulsivo podem fazer um encaminhamento para tratamento através da Linha de Apoio específica para esse fim. The Elixir programming language Home Install Learning Docs Guides Cases Blog Elixir is a dynamic, functional language for building scalable and maintainable applications. Elixir runs on the Erlang VM, known for creating low-latency, distributed, and fault-tolerant systems. These capabilities and Elixir tooling allow developers to be productive in several domains, such as web development, embedded software, machine learning, data pipelines, and multimedia processing, across a wide range of industries. Here is a peek: iex > "Elixir" |> String . graphemes () |> Enum . frequencies () %{ "E" => 1 , "i" => 2 , "l" => 1 , "r" => 1 , "x" => 1 } Check our Getting Started guide and our Learning page to begin your journey with Elixir. Or keep scrolling for an overview of the platform, language, and tools. Companies using Elixir in production See more cases → #embedded #nerves #collab #phoenix #otp #streaming #scaling #web #growth #team #web #virtual-spaces #phoenix #paas #phoenix #api #integration #xml #computer-vision #phoenix #open-data #gov #phoenix #messaging #broadway #real-time #genstage #otp #multiplayer #udp #otp #social #broadway #energy #iot #nerves #superbowl #mqtt #biz-intelligence #phoenix Platform features Scalability All Elixir code runs inside lightweight threads of execution (called processes) that are isolated and exchange information via messages: current_process = self () # Spawn an Elixir process (not an operating system one!) spawn_link ( fn -> send ( current_process , { :msg , "hello world" }) end ) # Block until the message is received receive do { :msg , contents } -> IO . puts ( contents ) end Due to their lightweight nature, you can run hundreds of thousands of processes concurrently in the same machine, using all machine resources efficiently (vertical scaling). Processes may also communicate with other processes running on different machines to coordinate work across multiple nodes (horizontal scaling). Together with projects such as Numerical Elixir , Elixir scales across cores, clusters, and GPUs. Fault-tolerance The unavoidable truth about software in production is that things will go wrong . Even more when we take network, file systems, and other third-party resources into account. To react to failures, Elixir supervisors describe how to restart parts of your system when things go awry, going back to a known initial state that is guaranteed to work: children = [ TCP . Pool , { TCP . Acceptor , port: 4040 } ] Supervisor . start_link ( children , strategy: :one_for_one ) The combination of fault-tolerance and message passing makes Elixir an excellent choice for event-driven systems and robust architectures. Frameworks, such as Nerves , build on this foundation to enable productive development of reliable embedded/IoT systems. Language features Functional programming Functional programming promotes a coding style that helps developers write code that is short, concise, and maintainable. For example, pattern matching allows us to elegantly match and assert specific conditions for some code to execute: def drive (% User { age: age }) when age >= 16 do # Code that drives a car end drive ( User . get ( "John Doe" )) #=> Fails if the user is under 16 Elixir relies on those features to ensure your software is working under the expected constraints. And when it is not, don't worry, supervisors have your back! Extensibility and DSLs Elixir has been designed to be extensible, allowing developers to naturally extend the language to particular domains, in order to increase their productivity. As an example, let's write a simple test case using Elixir's test framework called ExUnit : defmodule MathTest do use ExUnit . Case , async: true test "can add two numbers" do assert 1 + 1 == 2 end end The async: true option allows test s to run in parallel, using as many CPU cores as possible, while the assert functionality can introspect your code, providing great reports in case of failures. Other examples include using Elixir to write SQL queries , compiling a subset of Elixir to the GPU , and more. Tooling features A growing ecosystem Elixir ships with a great set of tools to ease development. Mix is a build tool that allows you to easily create projects, manage tasks, run tests and more: $ mix new my_app
$ cd my_app
$ mix test . Finished in 0.04 seconds (0.04s on load, 0.00s on tests) 1 test, 0 failures Mix also integrates with the Hex package manager for dependency management and hosting documentation for the whole ecosystem. Interactive development Tools like IEx (Elixir's interactive shell) leverage the language and platform to provide auto-complete, debugging tools, code reloading, as well as nicely formatted documentation: $ iex
Interactive Elixir - press Ctrl+C to exit (type h() ENTER for help)
iex> h String.trim           # Prints the documentation
iex> i "Hello, World"        # Prints information about a data type
iex> break! String.trim/1    # Sets a breakpoint
iex> recompile               # Recompiles the current project Code notebooks like Livebook allow you to interact with Elixir directly from your browser, including support for plotting, flowcharts, data tables, machine learning, and much more! Erlang compatible Elixir runs on the Erlang VM giving developers complete access to Erlang's ecosystem, used by companies like WhatsApp , Klarna , and many more to build distributed, fault-tolerant applications. An Elixir programmer can invoke any Erlang function with no runtime cost: iex > :crypto . hash ( :sha256 , "Using crypto from Erlang OTP" ) << 192 , 223 , 75 , 115 , ...>> To learn more about Elixir, check our Getting Started guide . ILD/pneumonitis occurred in 4% of the 1813 patients treated with TAGRISSO monotherapy who had not received recent definitive chemoradiation therapy; 0.4% of cases were fatal ILD/Pneumonitis with TAGRISSO in combination with Pemetrexed and Platinum-based Chemotherapy: In the FLAURA2 study, ILD/pneumonitis occurred in 3.3% of the 276 patients who received TAGRISSO in combination with pemetrexed and platinum-based chemotherapy; 0.4% of cases were fatal ILD/Pneumonitis Following Definitive Platinum-based Chemoradiation Therapy (CRT): In the LAURA study, following definitive platinum-based CRT, ILD/pneumonitis including radiation pneumonitis, occurred in 80 of the 143 patients (56%) who received TAGRISSO monotherapy and 28 of the 73 patients (38%) who received placebo. There was one fatal case (0.7%), 3.5% Grade 3, 34% Grade 2, and 18% Grade 1 adverse reactions of ILD/pneumonitis in TAGRISSO-treated patients. For TAGRISSO-treated patients, ILD/pneumonitis led to permanent discontinuation of TAGRISSO in 7% of patients and dosage interruptions of TAGRISSO in 35% of patients. Among the 46 patients who were rechallenged with TAGRISSO, 11% had recurrence of ILD/pneumonitis. In the 80 TAGRISSO-treated patients, ILD/pneumonitis resolved in 40%, resolved with sequelae in 1.3%, were resolving in 16%, did not resolve in 41%, and resulted in death in 1.3% For patients receiving TAGRISSO who have not received recent definitive platinum-based CRT, withhold TAGRISSO and promptly investigate for ILD in patients who present with worsening of respiratory symptoms which may be indicative of ILD (e.g., dyspnea, cough, and fever). Permanently discontinue TAGRISSO if ILD/pneumonitis is confirmed. For patients who have received recent definitive platinum-based CRT with Grade 1 ILD/pneumonitis, continue TAGRISSO or interrupt and restart, as appropriate. Permanently discontinue TAGRISSO in patients diagnosed with Grade ≥2 ILD/pneumonitis TAGRISSO can cause heart rate-corrected QT (QTc) interval prolongation. Of the 1813 TAGRISSO monotherapy-treated patients in clinical trials, 1.1% were found to have a QTc >500 msec, and 4.3% of patients had an increase from baseline QTc >60 msec. Of the 276 patients treated with TAGRISSO in combination with pemetrexed and platinum-based chemotherapy in the FLAURA2 study, 1.8% were found to have a QTc >500 msec, and 10.5% of patients had an increase from baseline QTc >60 msec. No QTc-related arrhythmias were reported. Clinical trials of TAGRISSO did not enroll patients with baseline QTc of >470 msec. Conduct periodic monitoring with ECGs and electrolytes in patients with congenital long QTc syndrome, congestive heart failure, electrolyte abnormalities, or those who are taking medications known to prolong the QTc interval. Permanently discontinue TAGRISSO in patients who develop QTc interval prolongation with signs/symptoms of life-threatening arrhythmia TAGRISSO can cause cardiomyopathy, including cardiac failure, chronic cardiac failure, congestive heart failure, pulmonary edema or decreased ejection fraction. Cardiomyopathy occurred in 3.8% of the 1813 TAGRISSO-treated patients; 0.1% of cardiomyopathy cases were fatal. In the FLAURA2 study, cardiomyopathy occurred in 9% of the 276 patients who received TAGRISSO in combination with pemetrexed and platinum-based chemotherapy; 1.1% of cardiomyopathy cases were fatal. A decline in left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≥10% from baseline and to <50% LVEF occurred in 4.2% of 1557 patients who had baseline and at least one follow-up LVEF assessment. In the ADAURA study, 1.5% (5/325) of TAGRISSO-treated patients experienced LVEF decreases ≥10% from baseline and a drop to <50%. In the LAURA study, following platinum-based CRT, 3% (4/135) of TAGRISSO-treated patients and no placebo-treated patients experienced LVEF decreases ≥10% and a drop to <50%. In the FLAURA2 study, 8% (21/262) of patients treated with TAGRISSO in combination with pemetrexed and platinum-based chemotherapy, who had baseline and at least one follow-up LVEF assessment, experienced LVEF decreases ≥10% and a drop to <50%. For patients receiving TAGRISSO monotherapy, conduct cardiac monitoring in patients with cardiac risk factors, including assessment of LVEF at baseline and during treatment. For patients receiving TAGRISSO in combination with pemetrexed and platinum-based chemotherapy, conduct cardiac monitoring in all patients, including assessment of LVEF at baseline and during treatment. Assess LVEF in patients who develop relevant cardiac signs or symptoms during treatment. For symptomatic congestive heart failure, permanently discontinue TAGRISSO Keratitis was reported in 0.6% of 1813 patients treated with TAGRISSO monotherapy in clinical trials. Promptly refer patients with signs and symptoms suggestive of keratitis (such as eye inflammation, lacrimation, light sensitivity, blurred vision, eye pain and/or red eye) to an ophthalmologist Postmarketing cases consistent with erythema multiforme major (EMM), Stevens-Johnson syndrome (SJS) and toxic epidermal necrolysis (TEN) have been reported in patients receiving TAGRISSO. Withhold TAGRISSO if EMM, SJS, or TEN is suspected and permanently discontinue if confirmed Postmarketing cases of cutaneous vasculitis including leukocytoclastic vasculitis, urticarial vasculitis, and IgA vasculitis have been reported in patients receiving TAGRISSO. Withhold TAGRISSO if cutaneous vasculitis is suspected, evaluate for systemic involvement, and consider dermatology consultation. If no other etiology can be identified, consider permanent discontinuation of TAGRISSO based on severity Aplastic anemia has been reported in TAGRISSO-treated patients in clinical trials (0.06% of 1813) and postmarketing. Some cases had a fatal outcome. Inform patients of the signs and symptoms of aplastic anemia including but not limited to, new or persistent fevers, bruising, bleeding, and pallor. If aplastic anemia is suspected, withhold TAGRISSO and obtain a hematology consultation. If aplastic anemia is confirmed, permanently discontinue TAGRISSO. IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION There are no contraindications for TAGRISSO TAGRISSO can cause severe and fatal interstitial lung disease (ILD)/pneumonitis. ILD/pneumonitis occurred in 4% of the 1813 patients treated with TAGRISSO monotherapy who had not received recent definitive chemoradiation therapy; 0.4% of cases were fatal ILD/Pneumonitis with TAGRISSO in combination with Pemetrexed and Platinum-based Chemotherapy: In the FLAURA2 study, ILD/pneumonitis occurred in 3.3% of the 276 patients who received TAGRISSO in combination with pemetrexed and platinum-based chemotherapy; 0.4% of cases were fatal ILD/Pneumonitis Following Definitive Platinum-based Chemoradiation Therapy (CRT): In the LAURA study, following definitive platinum-based CRT, ILD/pneumonitis including radiation pneumonitis, occurred in 80 of the 143 patients (56%) who received TAGRISSO monotherapy and 28 of the 73 patients (38%) who received placebo. There was one fatal case (0.7%), 3.5% Grade 3, 34% Grade 2, and 18% Grade 1 adverse reactions of ILD/pneumonitis in TAGRISSO-treated patients. For TAGRISSO-treated patients, ILD/pneumonitis led to permanent discontinuation of TAGRISSO in 7% of patients and dosage interruptions of TAGRISSO in 35% of patients. Among the 46 patients who were rechallenged with TAGRISSO, 11% had recurrence of ILD/pneumonitis. In the 80 TAGRISSO-treated patients, ILD/pneumonitis resolved in 40%, resolved with sequelae in 1.3%, were resolving in 16%, did not resolve in 41%, and resulted in death in 1.3% For patients receiving TAGRISSO who have not received recent definitive platinum-based CRT, withhold TAGRISSO and promptly investigate for ILD in patients who present with worsening of respiratory symptoms which may be indicative of ILD (e.g., dyspnea, cough, and fever). Permanently discontinue TAGRISSO if ILD/pneumonitis is confirmed. For patients who have received recent definitive platinum-based CRT with Grade 1 ILD/pneumonitis, continue TAGRISSO or interrupt and restart, as appropriate. Permanently discontinue TAGRISSO in patients diagnosed with Grade ≥2 ILD/pneumonitis TAGRISSO can cause heart rate-corrected QT (QTc) interval prolongation. Of the 1813 TAGRISSO monotherapy-treated patients in clinical trials, 1.1% were found to have a QTc >500 msec, and 4.3% of patients had an increase from baseline QTc >60 msec. Of the 276 patients treated with TAGRISSO in combination with pemetrexed and platinum-based chemotherapy in the FLAURA2 study, 1.8% were found to have a QTc >500 msec, and 10.5% of patients had an increase from baseline QTc >60 msec. No QTc-related arrhythmias were reported. Clinical trials of TAGRISSO did not enroll patients with baseline QTc of >470 msec. Conduct periodic monitoring with ECGs and electrolytes in patients with congenital long QTc syndrome, congestive heart failure, electrolyte abnormalities, or those who are taking medications known to prolong the QTc interval. Permanently discontinue TAGRISSO in patients who develop QTc interval prolongation with signs/symptoms of life-threatening arrhythmia TAGRISSO can cause cardiomyopathy, including cardiac failure, chronic cardiac failure, congestive heart failure, pulmonary edema or decreased ejection fraction. Cardiomyopathy occurred in 3.8% of the 1813 TAGRISSO-treated patients; 0.1% of cardiomyopathy cases were fatal. In the FLAURA2 study, cardiomyopathy occurred in 9% of the 276 patients who received TAGRISSO in combination with pemetrexed and platinum-based chemotherapy; 1.1% of cardiomyopathy cases were fatal. A decline in left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≥10% from baseline and to <50% LVEF occurred in 4.2% of 1557 patients who had baseline and at least one follow-up LVEF assessment. In the ADAURA study, 1.5% (5/325) of TAGRISSO-treated patients experienced LVEF decreases ≥10% from baseline and a drop to <50%. In the LAURA study, following platinum-based CRT, 3% (4/135) of TAGRISSO-treated patients and no placebo-treated patients experienced LVEF decreases ≥10% and a drop to <50%. In the FLAURA2 study, 8% (21/262) of patients treated with TAGRISSO in combination with pemetrexed and platinum-based chemotherapy, who had baseline and at least one follow-up LVEF assessment, experienced LVEF decreases ≥10% and a drop to <50%. For patients receiving TAGRISSO monotherapy, conduct cardiac monitoring in patients with cardiac risk factors, including assessment of LVEF at baseline and during treatment. For patients receiving TAGRISSO in combination with pemetrexed and platinum-based chemotherapy, conduct cardiac monitoring in all patients, including assessment of LVEF at baseline and during treatment. Assess LVEF in patients who develop relevant cardiac signs or symptoms during treatment. For symptomatic congestive heart failure, permanently discontinue TAGRISSO Keratitis was reported in 0.6% of 1813 patients treated with TAGRISSO monotherapy in clinical trials. Promptly refer patients with signs and symptoms suggestive of keratitis (such as eye inflammation, lacrimation, light sensitivity, blurred vision, eye pain and/or red eye) to an ophthalmologist Postmarketing cases consistent with erythema multiforme major (EMM), Stevens-Johnson syndrome (SJS) and toxic epidermal necrolysis (TEN) have been reported in patients receiving TAGRISSO. Withhold TAGRISSO if EMM, SJS, or TEN is suspected and permanently discontinue if confirmed Postmarketing cases of cutaneous vasculitis including leukocytoclastic vasculitis, urticarial vasculitis, and IgA vasculitis have been reported in patients receiving TAGRISSO. Withhold TAGRISSO if cutaneous vasculitis is suspected, evaluate for systemic involvement, and consider dermatology consultation. If no other etiology can be identified, consider permanent discontinuation of TAGRISSO based on severity Aplastic anemia has been reported in TAGRISSO-treated patients in clinical trials (0.06% of 1813) and postmarketing. Some cases had a fatal outcome. Inform patients of the signs and symptoms of aplastic anemia including but not limited to, new or persistent fevers, bruising, bleeding, and pallor. If aplastic anemia is suspected, withhold TAGRISSO and obtain a hematology consultation. If aplastic anemia is confirmed, permanently discontinue TAGRISSO. Advise pregnant women of the potential risk to a fetus. Advise females of reproductive potential to use effective contraception during treatment with TAGRISSO and for 6 weeks after the last dose. IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION There are no contraindications for TAGRISSO TAGRISSO can cause severe and fatal interstitial lung disease (ILD)/pneumonitis. ILD/pneumonitis occurred in 4% of the 1813 patients treated with TAGRISSO monotherapy who had not received recent definitive chemoradiation therapy (CRT); 0.4% of cases were fatal. In the FLAURA2 study, ILD/pneumonitis occurred in 3.3% of the 276 patients who received TAGRISSO in combination with pemetrexed and platinum-based chemotherapy; 0.4% of cases were fatal. For patients receiving TAGRISSO who have not received recent definitive platinum-based CRT, withhold TAGRISSO and promptly investigate for ILD in patients who present with worsening of respiratory symptoms which may be indicative of ILD (e.g., dyspnea, cough, and fever). Permanently discontinue TAGRISSO if ILD/pneumonitis is confirmed TAGRISSO can cause heart rate-corrected QT (QTc) interval prolongation. Of the 1813 TAGRISSO monotherapy-treated patients in clinical trials, 1.1% were found to have a QTc >500 msec, and 4.3% of patients had an increase from baseline QTc >60 msec. Of the 276 patients treated with TAGRISSO in combination with pemetrexed and platinum-based chemotherapy in the FLAURA2 study, 1.8% were found to have a QTc >500 msec, and 10.5% of patients had an increase from baseline QTc >60 msec. No QTc-related arrhythmias were reported. Conduct periodic monitoring with ECGs and electrolytes in patients with congenital long QTc syndrome, congestive heart failure, electrolyte abnormalities, or those who are taking medications known to prolong the QTc interval. Permanently discontinue TAGRISSO in patients who develop QTc interval prolongation with signs/symptoms of life-threatening arrhythmia TAGRISSO can cause cardiomyopathy, including cardiac failure, chronic cardiac failure, congestive heart failure, pulmonary edema or decreased ejection fraction. Cardiomyopathy occurred in 3.8% of the 1813 TAGRISSO-treated patients; 0.1% of cardiomyopathy cases were fatal. In the FLAURA2 study, cardiomyopathy occurred in 9% of the 276 patients who received TAGRISSO in combination with pemetrexed and platinum-based chemotherapy; 1.1% of cardiomyopathy cases were fatal. A decline in left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≥10% from baseline and to <50% LVEF occurred in 4.2% of 1557 patients who had baseline and at least one follow-up LVEF assessment. In the FLAURA2 study, 8% (21/262) of patients treated with TAGRISSO in combination with pemetrexed and platinum- based chemotherapy, who had baseline and at least one follow-up LVEF assessment, experienced LVEF decreases ≥10% and a drop to <50%. For patients receiving TAGRISSO monotherapy, conduct cardiac monitoring in patients with cardiac risk factors, including assessment of LVEF at baseline and during treatment. For patients receiving TAGRISSO in combination with pemetrexed and platinum-based chemotherapy, conduct cardiac monitoring in all patients, including assessment of LVEF at baseline and during treatment. Assess LVEF in patients who develop relevant cardiac signs or symptoms during treatment. For symptomatic congestive heart failure, permanently discontinue TAGRISSO Keratitis was reported in 0.6% of 1813 patients treated with TAGRISSO monotherapy in clinical trials. Promptly refer patients with signs and symptoms suggestive of keratitis (such as eye inflammation, lacrimation, light sensitivity, blurred vision, eye pain and/or red eye) to an ophthalmologist Postmarketing cases consistent with erythema multiforme major (EMM), Stevens-Johnson syndrome (SJS) and toxic epidermal necrolysis (TEN) have been reported in patients receiving TAGRISSO. Withhold TAGRISSO if EMM, SJS, or TEN is suspected and permanently discontinue if confirmed Postmarketing cases of cutaneous vasculitis including leukocytoclastic vasculitis, urticarial vasculitis, and IgA vasculitis have been reported in patients receiving TAGRISSO. Withhold TAGRISSO if cutaneous vasculitis is suspected, evaluate for systemic involvement, and consider dermatology consultation. If no other etiology can be identified, consider permanent discontinuation of TAGRISSO based on severity Aplastic anemia has been reported in patients treated with TAGRISSO in clinical trials (0.06% of 1813) and postmarketing. Some cases had a fatal outcome. Inform patients of the signs and symptoms of aplastic anemia including but not limited to, new or persistent fevers, bruising, bleeding, and pallor. If aplastic anemia is suspected, withhold TAGRISSO and obtain a hematology consultation. If aplastic anemia is confirmed, permanently discontinue TAGRISSO. Perform complete blood count with differential before starting TAGRISSO, periodically throughout treatment, and more frequently if indicated Verify pregnancy status of females of reproductive potential prior to initiating TAGRISSO. Advise pregnant women of the potential risk to a fetus. Advise females of reproductive potential to use effective contraception during treatment with TAGRISSO and for 6 weeks after the last dose. Advise males with female partners of reproductive potential to use effective contraception for 4 months after the last dose Because of the potential for serious adverse reactions in breastfed infants from TAGRISSO, women should not breastfeed during treatment with TAGRISSO and for 2 weeks after the last dose Most common (≥20%) adverse reactions, including laboratory abnormalities, were: TAGRISSO in combination with pemetrexed and platinum-based chemotherapy: leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, neutropenia, lymphopenia, rash, diarrhea, stomatitis, nail toxicity, dry skin, and increased blood creatinine INDICATION TAGRISSO is indicated in combination with pemetrexed and platinum-based chemotherapy, for the first-line treatment of adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC whose tumors have epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) exon 19 deletions or exon 21 L858R mutations, as detected by an FDA-approved test For additional information, please see the complete Prescribing Information , including Patient Information for TAGRISSO. A trademark holds significant power in the world of business, serving as a distinctive identifier for a company or its products. This practice has a rich history, with origins dating back to the Roman Empire. Despite the passage of time, the primary purpose of trademarks remains unchanged: safeguarding brand identity and aiding consumers in recognizing and trusting products. In the United States, federal trademark registration goes the extra mile by providing legal protection to trademark owners. Trademarks serve a crucial role in protecting brand identity, preventing consumer confusion, and incentivizing businesses to maintain quality. Trademark law safeguards the commercial source of products, ensuring that consumers can distinguish between different offerings in the market. Understanding trademark laws is essential for businesses to protect their brand and avoid legal disputes. Furthermore, trademarks encourage businesses to uphold quality standards, as a strong, protected brand identity is a valuable asset. Learn more › Why should I conduct a trademark search? When it comes to filing your trademark application, undertaking a comprehensive trademark search is crucial. This search ensures that the name you desire is not already in use. Furm offers an easy-to-use trademark search engine that allows you to explore millions of registered trademarks and pending applications. Here are the benefits of using Furm's free trademark search tool: Avoid Infringement: By conducting a trademark search, you can identify existing trademarks that may be similar to your desired name or logo. This helps you avoid potential infringement issues and legal disputes with other trademark owners. Protect Your Brand: A comprehensive trademark search allows you to safeguard your brand identity. By ensuring that your desired name or logo is not already in use, you can establish a unique and distinguishable brand that stands out in the marketplace. Increase Application Approval: When you submit a trademark application, it is more likely to be approved if your desired mark does not conflict with existing registered trademarks. By using a trademark search tool, you can minimize the risk of your application being rejected due to conflicts with prior registrations. Save Time and Resources: Conducting a trademark search early in the process helps you avoid investing time and resources into developing a brand that infringes on someone else's trademark. By identifying potential conflicts beforehand, you can make informed decisions and allocate resources effectively. Minimize Legal Costs: Resolving trademark disputes can be costly and time-consuming. By using a trademark search tool, you can proactively identify potential conflicts, reducing the likelihood of legal disputes and associated expenses. Enhance Brand Awareness: By conducting a trademark search, you can gain insights into existing trademarks within your industry. This knowledge can help you refine your brand strategy and differentiate your products or services, leading to increased brand awareness and consumer recognition. Secure Online Presence: In the digital age, having a unique online presence is crucial. A trademark search tool can help you identify existing trademarks that may impact your ability to secure relevant domain names, social media handles, and online trademarks, allowing you to establish a consistent and recognizable online brand presence. Make Informed Business Decisions: By understanding the trademark landscape, you can make informed business decisions related to branding, marketing, and product development. A trademark search tool provides valuable market intelligence that can influence your strategic choices and give you a competitive advantage. Peace of Mind: Conducting a trademark search and ensuring the availability of your desired mark provides peace of mind. It allows you to confidently invest in your brand, knowing that you have taken the necessary steps to protect it legally. By utilizing Furm, you can significantly reduce the risk of infringing on an existing trademark. Moreover, conducting a thorough search increases the chances of your application being approved when you submit it through USPTO's trademark electronic application system. Learn more › How much does a trademark cost? Trademark registration costs can be broadly categorized into three main components: government filing fees, attorney fees, and additional services. Each of these components plays a critical role in securing your brand’s legal protection and ensuring a smooth registration process. Learn more › How do I trademark a name? Trademarking your business name is a process that requires careful planning and execution. It involves conducting thorough research to ensure that your desired name is not already protected, preparing and filing your trademark application, and monitoring the progress of your application with the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO). O ViaMichelin tem uma aplicação móvel que me permite aceder a informações de tráfego rodoviário? ViaMichelin tem uma aplicação móvel gratuita . Está disponível para download gratuito para Apple e Android . Encontre mapas, itinerários e orientações Michelin com tráfego em tempo real, mapa 3D de navegação GPS com orientação por voz e alertas da comunidade. Clique aqui para descarregar a aplicação Apple Clique aqui para descarregar a aplicação Android Que tipos de itinerários podemos calcular no ViaMichelin? O ViaMichelin oferece cálculos de itinerários e distâncias entre cidades , endereços ou pontos de interesse com 4 modos de transporte possíveis: automóvel / moto / bicicleta / pedestre . Para itinerários de carro e moto , pode escolher entre as seguintes variantes: Recomendado pela Michelin: este percurso promove segurança, simplicidade e minimiza o risco de erros no percurso. Esse é o itinerário que a Michelin recomenda por padrão. Rápido (prioridade no tempo): esse itinerário é o que demora menos tempo para chegar ao seu destino. Curto (prioridade da distância): esse percurso é aquele para o qual a distância para chegar ao seu destino é mais curta, permanecendo em estradas transitáveis. Descoberta: este itinerário promove rotas pitorescas de interesse turístico. Barato: este itinerário oferece um percurso que otimiza o consumo de combustível e evita a passagem pelas estradas com portagens. Pode adicionar até 6 etapas ao seu percurso. Essas etapas também serão incluídas no GPS da aplicação do ViaMichelin se tiver registado o seu itinerário na sua conta Michelin. Para um itinerário calculado, o ViaMichelin geralmente oferece a escolha entre 2 ou 3 itinerários e permite compará-los facilmente . O ViaMichelin também fornece os custos detalhados do seu trajeto: custo do combustível adaptado ao seu veículo e custo das portagens em toda a Europa. O ViaMichelin oferece informações de trânsito em tempo real? ViaMichelin oferece informações de trânsito em tempo real . Para preparar melhor as suas viagens, encontrará, no nosso site, engarrafamentos, acidentes de trânsito ou obras na cidade que lhe interessa, além de lentidão de automóveis ou condições climáticas (neve, chuva, gelo). O tempo de viagem indicado no cálculo do itinerário tem em consideração as condições de tráfego. O impacto do tráfego no tempo da viagem é indicado na secção "Tempo" do resumo do itinerário. Podemos reservar alojamentos no ViaMichelin? O ViaMichelin oferece reservas de alojamentos sem custos adicionais . Em parceria com a Booking, oferecemos uma ampla variedade de alojamentos (hotéis, pousadas, B&B, parques de campismo, apartamentos) no local da sua escolha. Também pode consultar e reservar um dos hotéis selecionados no Guia MICHELIN. O melhor do ViaMichelin: escolha um hotel ao longo do seu itinerário ou próximo do seu destino de chegada , e aceda à seleção de hotéis Michelin através do filtro proposto na lista de resultados. Podemos consultar ou reservar um restaurante no ViaMichelin? O ViaMichelin oferece-lhe acesso gratuito a dados sobre restaurantes no Guia MICHELIN , em qualquer parte do mundo. Para restaurantes que assim o permitem, é oferecido um serviço de reserva online gratuito . Também pode reservar um restaurante que não faça parte da seleção MICHELIN, para uma pausa gourmet no seu trajeto ou no seu destino. Sophistio - chytré řízení energií PŘIHLÁSIT SE Inteligentní řízení Inteligentní řízení solárních elektráren Prediktivní řízení tepelných čerpadel Řízení komunitní energetiky Sběr dat Obecné řízení vytápění Podporovaná zařízení Ceník Kontakt Spolupráce Opravdové inteligentní řízení pro Vaše energie Sophistio je unikátní cloudová platforma pro inteligentní řízení solárních elektráren, tepelných čerpadel, komunitní energetiky a dalších energetických systémů. Dokáže predikovat výrobu a spotřebu energie a řídit spotřebiče tak, aby byl jejich provoz efektivní a přinášel maximální možnou úsporu. "Systém, který si nepamatuje svou minulost, nemá budoucnost." -- naše motto -- Dlouhodobý sběr dat Základním předpokladem pro správné řízení systémů, je dlouhodobě sbírat a uchovávat všechny důležité veličiny. Tyto informace slouží nejen k vytváření prediktivních modelů chování, ale i k dohledu správné funkce. Umělá inteligence pro predikce Data o chování v minulosti jsou pomocí strojového učení využívána k vytváření velmi přesných předpovědí chování v budoucnosti. U solární elektrárny se systém naučí predikovat výrobu aniž by znal orientaci panelů. V systémech vytápění si sám určí model tepelných ztrát. Řešení jako služba Celé řešení funguje moderním způsobem jako on-line služba "Control as a Service". Napojení je možné přes HTTP API nebo MQTT a není závislé na zařízeních konkrétních výrobců. Sophistio může řídit jakýkoliv systém, který dokáže poskytnout data a následně zpracovat řídící veličiny. Inteligentní řízení solárních elektráren Neprodávejte elektřinu levně, abyste ji mohli později draze koupit. Solární elektrárna mnohdy svému majiteli nepřináší očekávanou úsporu. Důvod bývá jednoduchý - většina vyrobené energie odteče bez využití do sítě a později je potřeba ji zase nakoupit. Naše řízení určí předpověď výroby a snaží se postupně spouštět všechny spotřebiče tak, aby se maximum energie využilo. Pokud je solární energie nedostatek, řízení zajistí, aby se odebírala ze sítě v okamžicích nejnižších cen. Zjistit více Prediktivní řízení tepelných čerpadel Získejte z tepelného čerpadla ještě více energie. Účinnost tepelného čerpadla je závislá na venkovní teplotě a vlhkosti. Většina čerpadel je řízena ekvitermní regulací, která podle klesající venkovní teploty přidává výkon. Tento styl řízení jde ale přímo proti energetické účinnosti. Prediktivní řízení se snaží vytěžit maximum energie v okamžicích nejlepších podmínek. 
                Ideální je spojení tepelného čerpadla a solární elektrárny, kdy lze díky inteligentnímu řízení dosáhnout úspor v řádu desítek procent. Zjistit více Řízení komunitní energetiky Spotřebovávejte energii mezi sebou. Komunitní energetika umožňuje sdílet vyrobenou energii v rámci uzavřené skupiny odběrných míst. Základem pro úspěšné fungování je dokázat řídit spotřebu mnoha spotřebičů rozprostřených v mnoha bytech či budovách pomocí přidělených klíčů a využít maximum vyrobené energie. Naše technologie je díky on-line platformě a komplexnímu fungování přes internet k tomuto účelu přímo stvořená. Zjistit více Sběr dat Sledujte co se děje s Vašimi systémy. Dlouhodobý sběr dat je základem pro naše fungování. Data ale nemusí sloužit jen jako základ pro kvalitní řízení, ale dávají i dokonalý přehled o správné funkci. Rozhraní pro sběr dat a nástroje pro dohled jsou univerzální a můžete je tedy používat pro jakýkoliv řídící systém. Zjistit více Obecné řízení vytápění Netopte, když to za chvíli udělá slunce za Vás. Obdobně jako se prediktivně řídí tepelná čerpadla se dají řídit jakékoliv systémy vytápění. Model predikce spotřeby tepla určí předpokládané ztráty s ohledem na akumulační schopnosti budovy a předpověď počasí a optimalizuje množství a časy dodávky. V případě proměnné ceny energií je možné také spotřebu tepla optimalizovat podle ceny a využít akumulace budovy. Ver la respuesta Es darle los alimentos que mejor se adaptan a las necesidades específicas del bebé, tanto en calidad como en cantidad, en el momento adecuado. En un principio, se empieza por introducir alimentos que completen los aportes de la leche materna o infantil para más adelante sustituirla en parte, coincidiendo con una disminución progresiva de las cantidades hasta llegar a un aporte recomendado de 500 ml al día. Cuando el bebé ha cumplido los 4 meses, se introducen los primeros cereales infantiles para completar la leche materna o infantil, seguidos por las frutas y las verduras. Posteriormente, a medida que se reduce la proporción de leche materna o infantil, se estructuran las comidas introduciendo de modo progresivo la carne o el pescado en torno a los 6 o 7 meses. Este esquema permite dar respuesta de forma precisa a las necesidades del bebé, ya que le aporta todos los nutrientes necesarios para su crecimiento y le ayuda a crear unos buenos hábitos alimentarios para el día de mañana. ¿Qué sitio ocupan los cereales en la alimentación del bebé? Ver la respuesta En los primeros intentos de diversificación alimentaria, el médico suele recomendar la introducción de los cereales para acostumbrar al bebé al descubrimiento de nuevos sabores de forma no traumática. ¿Son seguras las leches infantiles? Ver la respuesta Las leches infantiles de Nestlé son seguras para la salud de los recién nacidos. Nestlé garantiza que sus leches infantiles son totalmente seguras y están alineadas con las indicaciones de las organizaciones internacionales de seguridad alimentaria y de las autoridades locales. 403 - FORBIDDEN ERROR 403 - FORBIDDEN Why am I seeing this page? 403 errors usually mean that the server does not have permission to view the requested file or resource.These errors are often caused by IP Deny rules, File protections, or permission problems. In many cases this is not an indication of an actual problem with the server itself but rather a problem with the information the server has been instructed to access as a result of the request. This error is often caused by an issue on your site which may require additional review by our support teams. Our support staff will be happy to assist you in resolving this issue. Please contact our Live Support or reply to any Tickets you may have received from our technicians for further assistance. Is there anything that I can do? There are a few common causes for this error code including problems with the individual script that may be executed upon request. Some of these are easier to spot and correct than others. File and Directory Ownership The server you are on runs applications in a very specific way in most cases. The server generally expects files and directories be owned by your specific user cPanel user . If you have made changes to the file ownership on your own through SSH please reset the Owner and Group appropriately. File and Directory Permissions The server you are on runs applications in a very specific way in most cases. The server generally expects files such as HTML, Images, and other media to have a permission mode of 644 . The server also expects the permission mode on directories to be set to 755 in most cases. (See the Section on Understanding Filesystem Permissions.) Note: If the permissions are set to 000 , please contact our support team using the ticket system. This may be related to an account level suspension as a result of abuse or a violation of our Terms of Service. IP Deny Rules In the .htaccess file, there may be rules that are conflicting with each other or that are not allowing an IP address access to the site. If you would like to check a specific rule in your .htaccess file you can comment that specific line in the .htaccess by adding # to the beginning of the line. You should always make a backup of this file before you start making changes. For example, if the .htaccess looks like Order deny,allow allow from all deny from 192.168.1.5 deny from 192.168.1.25 Then try something like this Order allow,deny allow from all #deny from 192.168.1.5 deny from 192.168.1.25 Our server administrators will be able to advise you on how to avoid this error if it is caused by process limitations. Please contact our Live Support or open a Ticket. Be sure to include the steps needed for our support staff to see the 403 error on your site. Understanding Filesystem Permissions Symbolic Representation The first character indicates the file type and is not related to permissions. The remaining nine characters are in three sets, each representing a class of permissions as three characters. The first set represents the user class. The second set represents the group class. The third set represents the others class. Each of the three characters represent the read, write, and execute permissions: r if reading is permitted, - if it is not. w if writing is permitted, - if it is not. x if execution is permitted, - if it is not. The following are some examples of symbolic notation: - rwx r-x r-x a regular file whose user class has full permissions and whose group and others classes have only the read and execute permissions. c rw- rw- r-- a character special file whose user and group classes have the read and write permissions and whose others class has only the read permission. d r-x --- --- a directory whose user class has read and execute permissions and whose group and others classes have no permissions. Numeric Representation Another method for representing permissions is an octal (base-8) notation as shown. This notation consists of at least three digits. Each of the three rightmost digits represents a different component of the permissions: user , group , and others . Each of these digits is the sum of its component bits As a result, specific bits add to the sum as it is represented by a numeral: The read bit adds 4 to its total (in binary 100), The write bit adds 2 to its total (in binary 010), and The execute bit adds 1 to its total (in binary 001). These values never produce ambiguous combinations. each sum represents a specific set of permissions. More technically, this is an octal representation of a bit field – each bit references a separate permission, and grouping 3 bits at a time in octal corresponds to grouping these permissions by user , group , and others . Permission mode 0 7 5 5 4+2+1=7 Read, Write, eXecute 4+1=5 Read, eXecute 4+1=5 Read, eXecute Permission mode 0 6 4 4 4+2=6 Read, Write 4 Read 4 Read How to modify your .htaccess file The .htaccess file contains directives (instructions) that tell the server how to behave in certain scenarios and directly affect how your website functions. Redirects and rewriting URLs are two very common directives found in a .htaccess file, and many scripts such as WordPress, Drupal, Joomla and Magento add directives to the .htaccess so those scripts can function. It is possible that you may need to edit the .htaccess file at some point, for various reasons.This section covers how to edit the file in cPanel, but not what may need to be changed.(You may need to consult other articles and resources for that information.) There are Many Ways to Edit a .htaccess File Edit the file on your computer and upload it to the server via FTP Use an FTP program's Edit Mode Use SSH and a text editor Use the File Manager in cPanel The easiest way to edit a .htaccess file for most people is through the File Manager in cPanel. How to Edit .htaccess files in cPanel's File Manager Before you do anything, it is suggested that you backup your website so that you can revert back to a previous version if something goes wrong. Open the File Manager Log into cPanel. In the Files section, click on the File Manager icon. Check the box for Document Root for and select the domain name you wish to access from the drop-down menu. Make sure Show Hidden Files (dotfiles) " is checked. Click Go . The File Manager will open in a new tab or window. Look for the .htaccess file in the list of files. You may need to scroll to find it. To Edit the .htaccess File Right click on the .htaccess file and click Code Edit from the menu. Alternatively, you can click on the icon for the .htaccess file and then click on the Code Editor icon at the top of the page. A dialogue box may appear asking you about encoding. Just click Edit to continue. The editor will open in a new window. Edit the file as needed. Click Save Changes in the upper right hand corner when done. The changes will be saved. Test your website to make sure your changes were successfully saved. If not, correct the error or revert back to the previous version until your site works again. Once complete, you can click Close to close the File Manager window. How to modify file and directory permissions The permissions on a file or directory tell the server how in what ways it should be able to interact with a file or directory. This section covers how to edit the file permissions in cPanel, but not what may need to be changed.(See the section on what you can do for more information.) There are Many Ways to Edit a File Permissions Use an FTP program Use SSH and a text editor Use the File Manager in cPanel The easiest way to edit file permissions for most people is through the File Manager in cPanel. How to Edit file permissions in cPanel's File Manager Before you do anything, it is suggested that you backup your website so that you can revert back to a previous version if something goes wrong. Open the File Manager Log into cPanel. In the Files section, click on the File Manager icon. Check the box for Document Root for and select the domain name you wish to access from the drop-down menu. Make sure Show Hidden Files (dotfiles) " is checked. Click Go . The File Manager will open in a new tab or window. Look for the file or directory in the list of files. You may need to scroll to find it. To Edit the Permissions Right click on the file or directory and click Change Permissions from the menu. A dialogue box should appear allowing you to select the correct permissions or use the numerical value to set the correct permissions. Edit the file permissions as needed. Click Change Permissions in the lower left hand corner when done. The changes will be saved. Test your website to make sure your changes were successfully saved. If not, correct the error or revert back to the previous version until your site works again. Once complete, you can click Close to close the File Manager window.

DNS Resolution Error - Domain Not Found, Or Domain not added to hosting account DNS Resolution Error The domain you're trying to reach cannot be found 🔍 What's Happening? DNS Record Not Found: The Domain Name System (DNS) cannot locate the IP address for this domain. This means the website's DNS records either don't exist, haven't been configured properly, or haven't propagated across the internet yet. Or the requested domain is not yet added to an active hosting account. DNS (Domain Name System) is like the internet's phone book - it translates human-readable domain names (like example.com) into IP addresses that computers use to connect to websites. When you see this page, it means this translation process has failed. 🛠️ Quick Solutions 1. Flush Your DNS Cache Your computer stores DNS information temporarily. Clearing this cache can resolve outdated entries: Windows: ipconfig /flushdns macOS: sudo dscacheutil -flushcache Linux: sudo systemctl restart systemd-resolved 2. Try Different DNS Servers Switch to public DNS servers that might have more up-to-date records: Google Public DNS Primary: 8.8.8.8 Secondary: 8.8.4.4 Cloudflare DNS Primary: 1.1.1.1 Secondary: 1.0.0.1 Quad9 DNS Primary: 9.9.9.9 Secondary: 149.112.112.112 3. Wait for DNS Propagation ⏱️ Typical Propagation Times: Local ISP: 15 minutes - 2 hours Regional providers: 2 - 8 hours Global propagation: 24 - 48 hours Full propagation: Up to 72 hours 📚 Understanding DNS Propagation DNS propagation is the time it takes for DNS changes to spread across the internet's network of DNS servers worldwide. When a domain's DNS records are created or updated, these changes don't happen instantly everywhere. Why Does Propagation Take Time? Caching: DNS servers cache records for a specified time (TTL - Time To Live) Global Network: Thousands of DNS servers worldwide need to update ISP Policies: Some internet providers refresh DNS records on their own schedule Geographic Location: Servers closer to the authoritative DNS update faster 🔧 Advanced Troubleshooting Check DNS Resolution Use these commands to test DNS resolution: nslookup yourdomain.com
dig yourdomain.com
ping yourdomain.com Try Different Networks Test the domain on: Mobile data (different ISP) Different WiFi network VPN connection Public WiFi 🌐 Helpful Resources Google Public DNS Setup instructions Cloudflare DNS Fast DNS resolver 🕐 What to Do Now Try the quick solutions above - flush DNS cache and try different DNS servers Wait 2-4 hours and try again if this is a new domain or recent DNS change Test from different devices/networks to isolate the issue This page is displayed when DNS resolution fails for a domain. #維持費 #車検 車検に通る？通らない？注意したいパーツ・カスタム23点 もっと見る 安心でお得に車検・修理するためのヒント 車検と法定24ヶ月点検は必ずセットで実施しよう 新車は3年、それ以降は2年に一度の車検。格安をうたう車検業者の中には法定24ヶ月点検の整備料が含まれていない場合があります。車検と同じく法定点検も義務ですので、必ず車検費用見積もりの内訳を確認しましょう。 法定費用はどこでも同じ。車検整備を安くするポイントは？ 車検の際に必要な税金や自賠責保険などの法定費用はどこでも同じです。実施場所によって大きく異なるのは点検・整備費用。車検を通すだけの最低限の整備か、故障を防ぐために予防的な整備も行うのかで変わります。 ディーラーの車検整備や修理費用はなぜ高い？ メーカーディーラー系の車検整備や修理費用は相場よりも高めです。2年後の次の車検までの予防的な整備を実施すること、純正の新品部品を使用すること、工賃が高めに設定されていることなどがその理由です。 自分にあった整備・修理を望むなら柔軟な対応ができる工場を探そう 次の買い替え予定が近い、自分である程度の整備はできるなど、最低限の整備や修理を望む人は、整備内容の取捨選択だけでなく中古・リビルト部品や社外部品の使用などに対応してくれる工場を探しましょう。 事前の見積もりと実際の見積もりに差が！点検を開始しないとわからないこともある 整備や故障修理の場合、事前の見積もりはあくまでも目安。実際に点検を開始してから追加整備や不具合箇所が見つかることもあります。自分が納得できる整備・修理か、作業開始前の最終見積もりを確認しましょう。 CM：カープレミア「ダンス」篇 （出演：GENERATIONS/香取慎吾/渡辺直美） ブランドムービー：「CAR LIFE IS MY LIFE」 （主演：北山宏光） 法定費用はどこでも同じ。車検整備を安くするポイントは？ 車検の際に必要な税金や自賠責保険などの法定費用はどこでも同じです。実施場所によって大きく異なるのは点検・整備費用。車検を通すだけの最低限の整備か、故障を防ぐために予防的な整備も行うのかで変わります。 ディーラーの車検整備や修理費用はなぜ高い？ メーカーディーラー系の車検整備や修理費用は相場よりも高めです。2年後の次の車検までの予防的な整備を実施すること、純正の新品部品を使用すること、工賃が高めに設定されていることなどがその理由です。 自分にあった整備・修理を望むなら柔軟な対応ができる工場を探そう 次の買い替え予定が近い、自分である程度の整備はできるなど、最低限の整備や修理を望む人は、整備内容の取捨選択だけでなく中古・リビルト部品や社外部品の使用などに対応してくれる工場を探しましょう。 事前の見積もりと実際の見積もりに差が！点検を開始しないとわからないこともある 整備や故障修理の場合、事前の見積もりはあくまでも目安。実際に点検を開始してから追加整備や不具合箇所が見つかることもあります。自分が納得できる整備・修理か、作業開始前の最終見積もりを確認しましょう。 Portez-le comme vous voulez Une des caractéristiques les plus appréciées du paréo est sa flexibilité d'utilisation. Au-delà de la plage, le paréo peut être porté lors de soirées d'été, de festivals ou même comme un accessoire pour aménager un look décontracté au quotidien. 

Les astuces de mode pour porter un paréo sont quasiment infinies. On peut le nouer autour du cou pour créer une robe, ou le draper sur une épaule pour un look élégant. Les plus créatifs peuvent expérimenter différentes techniques de nouage pour créer des pièces uniques. Par exemple, en pliant le paréo en triangle et en l'attachant derrière le dos, on peut réaliser un haut sexy et confortable. 

Pour les jours plus frais, il sert aussi de châle ou d'écharpe, offrant chaleur et style sans compromettre la mode. Que vous soyez en vacances ou à la maison, un paréo bien choisi peut ainsi faire toute la différence dans votre allure. Un accessoire de voyage indispensable Pour les globe-trotters, le paréo est l'un des accessoires les plus pratiques à emporter dans sa valise. Léger et peu encombrant, il offre une multitude d’applications, aidant à économiser de l'espace tout en ajoutant une touche de style. Lors de vos escapades, il peut agencer tous vos vêtements, se glisser rapidement dans votre sac et se déplier en un clin d'œil pour répondre à vos besoins. 

On peut l'utiliser comme pareo de plage en se baignant, comme serviette en le dépliants sur le sable, ou même comme un petit abri contre le vent en le plaçant comme un rideau temporaire autour d'une chaise. Ces caractéristiques rendent le paréo polyvalent, capable de s'adapter à différents environnements sans sacrifier le confort. 

Les amateurs de randonnée apprécieront également le paréo pour sa capacité à servir de tapis lorsque l'on souhaite se reposer sur le sol. En somme, le paréo est bien plus qu'un simple accessoire de mode ; c'est un véritable allié pour le voyageur, alliant fonctionnalité et style. Le paréo dans la mode durable Avec la montée de la conscience écologique dans le monde de la mode, le paréo refait surface comme une option de vêtement durable. De nombreuses marques adoptent des pratiques de production éthiques en utilisant des matériaux respectueux de l'environnement pour leur confection. Cela apporte non seulement une touche exotique à la garde-robe, mais contribue également à la préservation de notre planète. 

Sélectionner un paréo fabriqué à partir de coton organique ou de polyester recyclé est un choix bénéfique pour l'environnement. En optant pour des produits durables, nous soutenons l'éthique tout en profitant de la beauté intemporelle de ce vêtement classique. 

Adopter le paréo comme pièce maîtresse de votre garde-robe ne se limite pas seulement à l'esthétique ; c'est un geste vers un avenir plus responsable. En investissant dans des vêtements de qualité, nous faisons un choix qui dépasse la mode éphémère et contribue à une consommation plus réfléchie. Styles incontournables de paréo Lorsque l'on aborde le sujet du paréo, il est impossible de passer à côté des divers styles qui existent aujourd'hui. Les tendances de mode sont en constante évolution, et le paréo s'adapte à chaque saison, chaque occasion, tout en restant fidèle à ses racines. Un des styles les plus en vogue est le paréo tropical, souvent orné de motifs floraux et colorés qui évoquent l’île et la chaleur. Ces motifs apportent une ambiance estivale et rendent le paréo parfait pour les vacances à la plage.

Le style bohème est également très prisé. Les personnes qui adoptent ce look associent le paréo à des accessoires naturels, tels que des bijoux en coquillage, des chapeaux en paille et des sandales. C'est un style qui prône la liberté et l'expression de soi, que l'on recherche à capturer dans un look sans effort. L'élégance des tons neutres et terres du paréo bohème en fait une option très prisée pour un style décontracté mais raffiné.

Pour plus de sophistication, certains préfèrent opter pour des tissus de paréo en satin ou en soie, apportant une allure chic à n'importe quelles tenues. Le paréo peut également jouer avec des coupes asymétriques, créant un impact visuel fort. Les couleurs métallisées ou pastel s'ajoutent à ce style, offrant une touche de glamour qui est parfaite pour les soirées d'été ou les événements spéciaux. 

En somme, le paréo offre une palette de styles variés, permettant à chacun de trouver celui qui lui correspond le mieux. Que vous soyez en quête de simplicité ou d'élégance extravagante, il y aura toujours un paréo adapté à vos envies. Le paréo dans la mode tropicale Le paréo tropical est sans aucun doute le look incontournable pour l'été. Affichant des motifs lumineux et vivants qui évoquent les paysages exotiques, ce style est parfait pour la saison balnéaire. Souvent fabriqué à partir de matériaux légers comme le coton, il est facilement portable tout en offrant confort et praticité. 

Les motifs floraux, palmiers et coraux sont les plus courants dans les paréos tropicaux. Ces designs ajoutent de la vivacité à toute tenue de plage, attirant l’attention et créant une ambiance festive. Pour parfaire un look tropical, associez votre paréo à un bikini coloré, des lunettes de soleil et un chapeau de paille pour un style dans l’air du temps. 

En plus d'être utilisé à la plage, le paréo tropical peut également être intégré dans des looks d'été urbains, où ses motifs contextuels apportent une touche de fraîcheur à l'habillement quotidien. L'effet visuel que créent ces motifs innovants en fait un accessoire qui ne sera jamais dépassé. L'élégance du paréo bohème Adopter le style bohème avec un paréo évoque une quête de liberté et d'individualité. Les paréos associant des teintes naturelles, du lin ou du coton léger sont idéaux pour incarner cette tendance décontractée. En complément de bijoux artisanaux et d’accessoires en matières organiques, ces paréos accentuent l’esprit aventurier de leur porteur.

Un paréo en satin peut être associé à des couleurs délicates, pastel ou métalliques, permettant ainsi d'ajouter une touche glamour à tout événement, que ce soit un cocktail sur la plage ou une soirée d'été. Quelle est l'origine du paréo ? Le paréo trouve ses racines dans les îles de la Polynésie, où il est traditionnellement porté par les hommes et les femmes. Initialement appelé 'pareo', ce vêtement enroulé autour du corps est devenu un symbole de confort et d'élégance, représentant une mode insulaire et décontractée adoptée mondialement. Comment porter un paréo ? Le paréo peut être porté de plusieurs façons. Il peut être enroulé autour de la taille comme une jupe, drapé comme une robe, ou utilisé comme une écharpe d'été. Sa souplesse et sa légèreté en font un accessoire idéal pour s'adapter à différentes occasions, que ce soit à la plage ou lors d'une sortie décontractée. Quels tissus sont utilisés pour fabriquer des paréos ? Les paréos sont généralement fabriqués à partir de tissus légers et respirants comme la rayonne, le coton ou le polyester. Ces matériaux sont choisis pour leur confort et leur capacité à sécher rapidement, ce qui les rend parfaits pour les activités en bord de mer. De plus, ils sont souvent décorés de motifs colorés inspirés de la nature. Le paréo convient-il à toutes les morphologies ? Oui, le paréo est un vêtement extrêmement polyvalent qui convient à toutes les morphologies. Grâce à sa capacité à s'adapter à différentes façons de le porter, il permet de sublimer chaque silhouette. Sa flexibilité et ses différentes dimensions en font un choix idéal pour toutes les tailles et toutes les formes. Est-ce qu'il existe des styles de paréo pour différentes occasions ? Oui, les styles de paréo peuvent varier en fonction des occasions. Il existe des modèles plus sophistiqués, ornés de broderies et de motifs élégants, parfaits pour des événements semi-formels. Pour des journées décontractées à la plage, des paréos colorés et imprimés sont idéaux. Les options sont multiples, permettant de trouver le paréo parfait pour chaque événement. Application Fee: he application fee for the NDA 2023 exam is Rs. 100/- for all applicants. Applicants belonging to SC/ST/NCOs/Sons of JCOs/ORS categories are exempt from paying the application fee. The application fee can be paid through various modes such as credit card, debit card, net banking, or SBI challan. Eligibility Criteria To Appear For NDA Exam Applying for the NDA exam is the first stage of “how to join NDA”. The candidates applying for the NDA exam must be aware of the eligibility criteria to make out whether they are eligible to apply for or not. The eligibility criteria to apply for the NDA entrance exam is as given here. Nationality The candidates must either be A citizen of India, OR A subject of Bhutan, OR A subject of Nepal, OR A Tibetan refugee who came over to India before 1st January 1962 intending to permanently set in India, OR A person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka and East African Countries of Kenya, Uganda, the United Republic of Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire & Ethiopia or Vietnam intending to permanently settle in India (Provided that a candidate belonging to categories 2nd, 3rd, 4th and 5th above shall be a person in whose favor a certificate of eligibility has been issued by the Govt. of India.) Certificate of eligibility will not, however, be necessary in case of candidates who are Gorkha subjects of Nepal. Marital Status Only unmarried candidates are allowed to apply for the NDA exam. Age Limit The minimum age to apply for the NDA exam is 16.5 years and maximum age is 19.5 years. The candidates must have not born earlier than 2nd January 2000 and not later than 1st January 2004. The candidates applying for the Indian Army through NDA exam must have passed 12thfrom a recognized Board. The candidates applying for Indian Airforce & Indian Naval Academy through the NDA exam must have passed 12th having Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects from a recognized Board. The candidates who wish to get admission under the 10+2 Cadet Entry Scheme at Indian Naval Academy also have passed 12th having Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects from a recognized Board. Qualification Eligibility The candidates must have fulfilled the physical eligibility criteria as mentioned by the Ministry of Defence required for different wings (Indian Army, Navy, and Airforce). SELECTION PROCEDURE OF NDA “How to join NDA”, this is a quite common question for many candidates who wish to join NDA. Here you will get to know the stages to be qualified to get admission in NDA. The written examination is not the only stage to qualify to get an entry in NDA. The selection procedure for NDA consists of three stages- the Written entrance test, SSB Interview, and Medical Examination. The candidates who qualify all these stages will get admission to NDA to undergo training sessions. After the completion of training, the candidates will get posting in their respective departments. You can get trained by the India’s best NDA coaching institute in Dehradun. Dehradun is the place where lots of top NDA coaching in India are based. For more info, contact OGC – DDA’s experienced team. Written Examination Pattern Of NDA Exam It is good to start preparation as early as possible instead of keep on thinking “how to join NDA”. If you really aim to join the Indian Army, Navy or Air-force through NDA then you must start preparing from the beginning. You can choose best coaching institute for that. You also should have knowledge of the examination pattern of NDA. The entrance exam pattern of NDA will have 2 papers- Mathematics and General Ability Test. The General Ability Test will again have 2 parts- Part A (English) and Part B (General Knowledge). The total marks for the entrance exam pattern will be 900. Out of which, 300 marks will be for Mathematics paper and the rest 600 will be for General Ability Test. The examination will be conducted through offline mode. The question paper will of MCQ type. The duration of the NDA entrance exam will be 2 hours and 30 minutes. There will be a penalty for each incorrect answer (0.83 marks for Mathematics, 1.33 marks for English and GK). The question paper will be available both in Hindi and English. Syllabus For NDA Entrance Exam All the candidates should have complete knowledge about the NDA entrance exam syllabus. It will help them to prepare as per the prescribed syllabus of the NDA exam. As NDA exam has 2 papers- Mathematics and General Ability so you can go through the syllabus of both the paper as given below. Syllabus For Mathematics Mathematics syllabus includes the topics of Probability, Trigonometry, Algebra, Integral Calculus & Differential Equations, Vector Algebra, Analytical Geometry of Two & Three Dimensions, Matrices & Determinants, Determinant of a matrix, Types of Matrices, Statistics, etc. We can get trained by India’s top NDA coaching institute like Dehradun Defence Academy. Syllabus For General Ability General Ability test id divided into 2 parts- Part A (English) & Part B (General Knowledge). Past A includes English vocabulary, Grammar, Comprehension & Cohesion in extended text to analyze the ability of the candidates in English subject. Whereas, Part B includes the topics of General Knowledge, Current Affairs, History, Geography, Chemistry, and Physics. SSB Interview Or Service Selection Board The qualified candidates of the NDA written entrance exam will be called to attend the SSB Interview stage. SSB is another important and tough stage to be qualified to get success in NDA selection. It is a three-day interview schedule consisting of different tests and medical examinations. The qualified candidates of the SSB interview will be called for the next stage of NDA selection. Test your skills from top NDA coaching centers near you. Medical Examination This is the final stage of NDA selection. The successful candidates of NDA will be eligible to attend medical examinations conducted by the Board of Service Medical Officers. The candidates declared medically fit by the Board will get admission to the NDA academy where they will undergo training for the specified time period. Representation of real numbers on a line. Complex numbers—basic properties, modulus, argument, cube roots of unity. Binary system of numbers. Conversion of a number in the decimal system to binary system and vice-versa. Arithmetic, Geometric and Harmonic progressions. Quadratic equations with real coefficients. Adjoint and inverse of a square matrix, Applications-Solution of a system of linear equations in two or three unknowns by Cramer’s rule and by Matrix Method. (3) Trigonometry: Angles and their measures in degrees and in radians. Trigonometric ratios. Trigonometric identities Sum and difference formulae. Multiple and Sub-multiple angles. Inverse trigonometric functions. Applications-Height and distance, properties of triangles. (4) Analytical Geometry Of Two and Three Dimensions: Rectangular Cartesian Coordinate system. Derivative of function at a point, geometrical and physical interpretation of a derivative-application. Derivatives of sum, product and quotient of functions, derivative of a function with respect to another function, derivative of a composite function. Second order derivatives. Increasing and decreasing functions. Definition of order and degree of a differential equation, formation of a differential equation by examples. General and particular solution of differential equations, solution of first order and first degree differential equations of various types—examples. Application in problems of growth and decay. Unit and null vectors, addition of vectors, scalar multiplication of a vector, scalar product or dot product of two vectors. Vector product or cross product of two vectors. Applications—work done by a force and moment of a force and in geometrical problems. Union and Intersection of events. Complementary, elementary and composite events. Definition of probability—classical and statistical—examples. Elementary theorems on probability—simple problems. Conditional probability, Bayes’ theorem—simple problems. Random variable as function on a sample space. Binomial distribution, examples of random experiments giving rise to Binomial distribution. DNS Resolution Error - Domain Not Found, Or Domain not added to hosting account DNS Resolution Error The domain you're trying to reach cannot be found 🔍 What's Happening? DNS Record Not Found: The Domain Name System (DNS) cannot locate the IP address for this domain. This means the website's DNS records either don't exist, haven't been configured properly, or haven't propagated across the internet yet. Or the requested domain is not yet added to an active hosting account. DNS (Domain Name System) is like the internet's phone book - it translates human-readable domain names (like example.com) into IP addresses that computers use to connect to websites. When you see this page, it means this translation process has failed. 🛠️ Quick Solutions 1. Flush Your DNS Cache Your computer stores DNS information temporarily. Clearing this cache can resolve outdated entries: Windows: ipconfig /flushdns macOS: sudo dscacheutil -flushcache Linux: sudo systemctl restart systemd-resolved 2. Try Different DNS Servers Switch to public DNS servers that might have more up-to-date records: Google Public DNS Primary: 8.8.8.8 Secondary: 8.8.4.4 Cloudflare DNS Primary: 1.1.1.1 Secondary: 1.0.0.1 Quad9 DNS Primary: 9.9.9.9 Secondary: 149.112.112.112 3. Wait for DNS Propagation ⏱️ Typical Propagation Times: Local ISP: 15 minutes - 2 hours Regional providers: 2 - 8 hours Global propagation: 24 - 48 hours Full propagation: Up to 72 hours 📚 Understanding DNS Propagation DNS propagation is the time it takes for DNS changes to spread across the internet's network of DNS servers worldwide. When a domain's DNS records are created or updated, these changes don't happen instantly everywhere. Why Does Propagation Take Time? Caching: DNS servers cache records for a specified time (TTL - Time To Live) Global Network: Thousands of DNS servers worldwide need to update ISP Policies: Some internet providers refresh DNS records on their own schedule Geographic Location: Servers closer to the authoritative DNS update faster 🔧 Advanced Troubleshooting Check DNS Resolution Use these commands to test DNS resolution: nslookup yourdomain.com
dig yourdomain.com
ping yourdomain.com Try Different Networks Test the domain on: Mobile data (different ISP) Different WiFi network VPN connection Public WiFi 🌐 Helpful Resources Google Public DNS Setup instructions Cloudflare DNS Fast DNS resolver 🕐 What to Do Now Try the quick solutions above - flush DNS cache and try different DNS servers Wait 2-4 hours and try again if this is a new domain or recent DNS change Test from different devices/networks to isolate the issue This page is displayed when DNS resolution fails for a domain.
